<thought>Based on the 13C NMR data, there are six aromatic carbon signals (≈127–134 ppm) and one carbonyl signal (≈168 ppm). This suggests the molecule can be thought of as an aromatic fragment and a carbonyl fragment that could be joined. The simplest SMILES for these fragments are benzene (c1ccccc1) and a carboxylic‑acid carbonyl (C(=O)O).</thought>
<final_answer>['c1ccccc1', 'C(=O)O']</final_answer>
